title: Austin Leaders: Executive Session Declared
summary:
*   Austin's city leaders convened a special meeting on December 21, 1978.
*   The entire session immediately moved into a closed, executive meeting.
*   This private meeting was authorized by specific state statutes allowing confidentiality for certain sensitive discussions.
*   Any final actions or decisions resulting from the closed session were committed to be made in an open, public forum.
